things.name: the present house
things.who: designed by Thomas, 2nd Earl de Grey, for himself, with James Clephan as clerk of works

things.name: the conservatory
things.who: built with the house for Thomas, 2nd Earl de Grey, with a glazed roof on ornate cast-iron trusses

things.name: the Italian Garden
things.who: laid out for Thomas, 2nd Earl de Grey, beside the conservatory of his new house (one Heritage Fund page dates its layout to 1882)

things.name: the French Parterre
things.who: laid out for Thomas, 2nd Earl de Grey, in the French style to go with his new house

things.name: the restoration of the French Parterre
things.who: carried out by English Heritage to the Earl's design, after a full-area excavation in autumn 2011

things.name: the four lead statue groups on the parterre
things.who: attributed to John Cheere, bought by the 2nd Earl de Grey and in place by 1839

things.name: the start of the parterre statue restoration
things.who: begun by English Heritage, with conservators Skillington Workshop, on Venus and Adonis and Aeneas and Anchises

things.name: the Mermaid Basin
things.who: thought by Historic England to have been put up by Francis, 7th Earl Cowper, between 1880 and 1904 (Bedfordshire Archives says mid-1800s, by the 2nd Earl de Grey)

things.name: the ornamental dairy
things.who: built as part of the service wing of Thomas, 2nd Earl de Grey's new house

things.name: the Dairy Sculpture Gallery
things.who: made by English Heritage out of the ornamental dairy, to show garden statues too fragile to stay outdoors

things.name: the Silsoe entrance lodges
things.who: designed by Thomas, 2nd Earl de Grey, his first buildings in the Louis XV style

things.name: Le Petit Trianon playhouse
things.who: built in the grounds under Thomas, 2nd Earl de Grey, as a children's playhouse (the listing says for his children; his grandchildren seem likelier)

things.name: the Petit Trianon at Versailles
things.who: designed by Ange-Jacques Gabriel for Louis XV, and given to Marie Antoinette by Louis XVI in 1774

things.name: the Crystal Palace
things.who: designed by Joseph Paxton for the Great Exhibition

things.name: the Great Conservatory at Chatsworth
things.who: designed by Joseph Paxton for the 6th Duke of Devonshire

people.name: Thomas, 2nd Earl de Grey
people.who: the owner who built the present house, the Orangery and the French gardens; nephew of Amabel, Countess de Grey, from whom he inherited Wrest
events: built the Silsoe entrance lodges, his first Louis XV-style buildings (about this date)
became the first President of the Institute of British Architects
finished the new house and laid out the Italian Garden about this time
had the Petit Trianon playhouse built in the grounds

people.name: John Cheere
people.who: the London maker of lead garden statues from a yard at Hyde Park Corner, credited with the four lead groups on the French Parterre and thought to have made the William III statue
events: died; his remaining stock of statues was sold off

people.name: Marie Antoinette
people.who: the Habsburg archduchess and queen of France, youngest daughter of Empress Maria Theresa, who was given the Petit Trianon at Versailles
events: was given the Petit Trianon by Louis XVI
began the Queen's Hamlet at the Petit Trianon (finished about 1786)

people.name: Empress Maria Theresa
people.who: the Habsburg ruler of Austria, Hungary and Bohemia and mother of Marie Antoinette
events: became ruler of the Habsburg lands
